007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolAttributes;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolInput;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolStatus;
016
017import java.util.List;
018
019/**
020 * Creates a persistent custom tool with typed input names and descriptions.
021 * <p>
022 * Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD},
023 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME},
024 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_FUNCTION}, {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INSTRUCTION},
025 * and {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_NAME}. Optionally set
026 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_DESCRIPTION} and
027 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_DESCRIPTION}.
028 * <p>
029 * The named PL/SQL function must already exist, be accessible to the database
030 * user, and accept the named input. The database validates the tool definition.
031 * This sample does not create or execute the function and does not use
032 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_TYPE} or {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_PARAMS_JSON}.
033 * Add further {@link ToolInput} entries to the list when the function has
034 * additional inputs that need metadata.
035 * <p>
036 * Use a new tool name. Closing the client does not drop the tool. Run
037 * {@link DropToolSample} with the same tool name and connection settings to
038 * remove the created tool; the existing function is not removed.
039 *
040 * @see ToolInputSample
041 * @see SetToolInputsSample
042 * @see LoadToolSample
043 */
044public final class CreateToolWithInputsSample {
045
046    private CreateToolWithInputsSample() {
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * Creates input metadata without invoking the tool's function.
051     *
052     * @param args unused command-line arguments
053     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
054     */
055    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
056        String toolName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME");
057        ToolInput input = ToolInput.builder()
058                .name(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_NAME"))
059                .description(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_DESCRIPTION"))
060                .build();
061        ToolAttributes attributes = ToolAttributes.builder()
062                .function(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_FUNCTION"))
063                .instruction(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INSTRUCTION"))
064                .toolInputs(List.of(input))
065                .build();
066        DbConnectionConfig config = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
067                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
068                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
069                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
070                .build();
071
072        try (SelectAIAgent client = SelectAIAgent.create(config)) {
073            Tool tool = client.tool(toolName, attributes,
074                    env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_DESCRIPTION"), ToolStatus.ENABLED);
075            System.out.printf("Create tool '%s' completed: %s%n", toolName, tool.create());
076        }
077    }
078
079    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
080        String value = env(name);
081        if (value == null) {
082            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
083        }
084        return value;
085    }
086
087    private static String env(String name) {
088        String value = System.getenv(name);
089        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
090    }
091}
